text.en: Dog owners frequently praise the friendly atmosphere and welcoming demeanor of the salon staff. Reviews single out groomers like Stella, Nina, and Nilo for their skill, attentiveness, and gentle communication. Clients appreciate that staff members treat every visiting pet with genuine affection and respect.

Clients express great satisfaction with full grooming packages for breeds ranging from standard poodles to micro bernedoodles. Reviewers report that coats emerge soft, clean, and smelling fresh, with noticeable reductions in seasonal shedding. Owners also appreciate receiving finishing touches such as decorative neckbands.

Reviews highlight the team's ability to settle anxious or shy dogs during bathing and scissor work. Pet parents note that groomers take time to ease nervousness, ensuring appointments remain positive and comfortable. Dogs leave looking well-styled and showing relaxed body language following their grooming sessions.

q.en: Does Mr. Bodhi offer self-service dog wash facilities?

a.en: Yes, clients mention using the self-wash stations for quick DIY dog baths, noting clean facilities and friendly assistance.

q.en: How does the salon notify owners when grooming is nearly finished?

a.en: Reviewers appreciate receiving a convenient telephone or text message approximately thirty minutes before their dog is ready for collection.

q.en: Are loyalty discounts available for regular customers?

a.en: Pet parents report receiving loyalty discounts on recurring full-grooming appointments.

q.en: Can the salon groom large breeds like standard poodles?

a.en: Yes, reviews describe thorough and high-quality full grooming services for large and curly-coated breeds such as standard poodles.
